question: Which internal source should replace the Mercado Libre browser view for deciding which labels are emailed to Segmail each weekday?
rationale: The discussion already blocks browser automation, and choosing between pending-label orders, current picking contents, or the existing Meli-FedEx flow changes what the operation sends.

options.title: Use internal order state
options.body: Drive the email from MercadoLibre order sells that match a maintainer-approved status/filter and explicitly exclude canceled orders.

options.title: Wait for MercadoLibre API confirmation
options.body: Keep the issue blocked until operations confirms an API-backed or report-backed equivalent of “Envíos de hoy.”

options.title: Do not automate the email
options.body: Close the request if the risk of sending the wrong labels outweighs the daily manual saving.

recommendation.title: Use internal order state
recommendation.body: Drive the email from MercadoLibre order sells that match a maintainer-approved status/filter and explicitly exclude canceled orders.
